title: Add task graph command
description: Add a graph command that prints a tree of tasks and dependencies. Default view should show todo items, with a flag to request done, paused, inProgress, todo, or all.

comments.message: Recorded requested future work: add a graph command showing task and dependency trees with status filtering.
